name: edytor-laser-xeomsc
description: Interaktywny, parametryczny edytor projektów do cięcia i grawerowania laserowego — XeomscWoodArt / Xeomsc Laser.

scripts.start: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron .
scripts.start:trial: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js on && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron smoke-main.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron-builder --win --x64 -p never
scripts.dist:win:trial: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js on && electron-builder --win --x64 -p never -c electron-builder.trial.json
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron-builder --mac -p never
scripts.dist:mac:trial: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js on && electron-builder --mac -p never -c electron-builder.trial.json
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron-builder --linux -p never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js off && electron-builder --linux dir
scripts.pack:linux:trial: npm run prepare:app && node set-trial.js on && electron-builder --linux dir
